title: Researchers weaponize public OpenAI model to build zero-day Chrome exploit in six days
summary: XBOW researchers used OpenAI's publicly available GPT-5.6 Sol model to chain three Chrome zero-days into a full exploit in six days, costing ~$40,000 in AI charges. Google awarded the maximum $250,000 bounty after confirming and fixing all three vulnerabilities.
takeaways: Exploit built in 6 days (August 2–7, 2026) using public GPT model
AI charges cost approximately $40,000 per usage logs
Google awarded maximum $250,000 bug bounty
Vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-85045 (V8), CVE-2026-78952 (WebP decoder), and one unpatched Chrome component
Before LLMs, comparable exploit required ~4 engineers over 6–9 months

title: Microsoft Releases AI Model 35 Times Faster Than OpenAI's GPT-6
summary: Microsoft released Microsoft-Decision-1, a decision model 35 times faster than OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol on structured tasks. Built by fine-tuning Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B, it achieved highest accuracy across 36 benchmarks (150,000 blind questions) and costs $0.042 per million input tokens with free output.
takeaways: 35× faster than GPT-6 Sol on structured decision tasks; 2.5× faster than H2O-Lightning-4B v1.1
Highest accuracy across 36 benchmarks, 150,000 blind test questions
32,000-token context window; text input only
$0.042 per million input tokens; output tokens free
Xbox Research: competitive with GPT-6 Sol at 14× faster speed, 1/200th cost; Copilot: competitive with GPT5.6 Luna at 100× faster speed

title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, Claims Performance Advantage Over GPT-6 Astra
summary: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, claiming superior performance over OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra. On composite intelligence benchmarks, Carbon scored 60 versus Astra's 57, and achieved 53.9% success on real-world workplace automation tasks versus Astra's 41.4%. Carbon costs approximately 40% less than Astra
takeaways: Carbon intelligence score 60 vs. Astra 57 (Artificial Analysis composite index)
AutomationBench 1.0: Carbon 53.9% success rate vs. Astra 41.4% on 657 workplace tasks
API pricing: Carbon $4 input/$20 output per million tokens vs. Astra $10/$50 (40% cost savings)
Access requires Google AI Ultra plan at $100/month in US
